title: Temporal Logic Guided Universal Task Representations for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.15509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task guided agents demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of complex tasks. However, most existing task representation algorithms are tailored to specific contexts and struggle to generalize across diverse scenarios. Moreover, they typically depend on gradient signals from reinforcement learning controllers to update their weights, which can degrade both representation quality and learning efficiency. To overcome these limitations, we propose LOTUS, a temporal logic inspired universal task representation framework that can be seamlessly integrated into any RL algorithm to enhance agent performance across diverse task settings. Specifically, we design a novel task representation architecture capable of modeling relationships and extracting task semantics from LTL formulas. translated_title: 时间逻辑引导的强化学习通用任务表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15509v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：任务引导的智能体在广泛的复杂任务中表现出强大的性能。然而，现有的大多数任务表示算法是针对特定场景量身定制的，难以在不同情境中泛化。此外，它们通常依赖来自强化学习控制器的梯度信号来更新权重，这可能降低表示质量和学习效率。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了LOTUS，一种受时间逻辑启发的通用任务表示框架，可以无缝集成到任何强化学习算法中，以增强智能体在多样任务设置下的性能。具体来说，我们设计了一种新颖的任务表示架构，能够建模关系并从线性时间逻辑（LTL）公式中提取任务语义。我们进一步引入了一种更有效的更新机制，将LTL编码器视为策略，从而提升表示能力。为了增强稳定性...
tldr: 本文提出LOTUS，一种基于时间逻辑的通用任务表示框架，通过将LTL编码器作为策略更新，提升强化学习在多样任务中的性能和泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LOTUS, a temporal logic-inspired universal task representation framework that treats the LTL encoder as a policy for updating, enhancing RL performance and generalization across diverse tasks.
